caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright stoneware jug placed against a plain, light beige background. The jug is cylindrical with slightly rounded shoulders and a small, short neck that leads to a flat, circular rim. There is a small handle attached to the upper part near the neck. The surface of the jug is a light tan or grayish color with some mottling, and it features a decorative motif on its front composed of cobalt blue, swirling, and curved floral or foliate lines, with a central circular element. A horizontal blue band circles near the base and another faint blue band encircles the neck just below the rim. The jug casts a subtle shadow below and to the right, indicating the direction of light. There are no other objects in the composition.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
